articles.title: Trump admin has revoked over 1,75,000 visas since Jan 2025: Who is being targeted
articles.description: The US State Department has taken a bold step by revoking more than 175,000 visas for foreign nationals, primarily due to criminal activity and the misuse of the immigration system. This move follows serious law enforcement encounters resulting in visa cancellations. Additionally, the administration is tightening rules that could affect international students and H-1B visa holders, indicating a significant shift in immigration policy.

articles.title: Sourav Ganguly receives death threats; Kolkata Police begin probe
articles.description: Former India captain Sourav Ganguly has reported receiving threatening letters to the police.  His manager filed a complaint after two letters arrived with explicit threats.  The police are now investigating the source and motive behind these communications.  They are examining courier trails and tracking a mobile number for clues.  The investigation aims to identify the sender and ensure Ganguly's safety.

articles.title: Ryka Chopra, 17,used AI and game theory to find how countries could work together to save Arctic ice; now she is a US Regeneron STS finalist
articles.description: Ryka Chopra, a 17-year-old student at Mission San Jose High School in Fremont, California, is among the 40 finalists of the 2026 Regeneron Science Talent Search. Her project combines graph theory, game theory and reinforcement learning to model how nations' conservation decisions could affect Arctic ice loss. Simulating interactions among 25 Arctic-related nations and regions, her model found that appropriate incentives could encourage countries to cooperate on conservation while considering their economic interests.

articles.title: QS World University Rankings 2027: Indian institutions rise from 11 in 2015 to 52, says government
articles.description: India’s presence in global higher education has expanded significantly, with 52 Indian institutions featuring in the QS World University Rankings 2027, compared with 11 in 2015. The latest rankings show gains beyond the IITs, with 26 institutions improving their positions. The Centre attributed the progress to NIRF, NEP 2020, institutional expansion and higher education reforms.

articles.title: IIT faculty recruitment: Over 3,500 vacancies filled, but student-teacher ratio remains unclear
articles.description: More than 3,500 faculty vacancies have been filled across IITs between September 2022 and May 2026 under a mission-mode recruitment drive. However, the latest Lok Sabha response does not reveal the current faculty-student ratio at individual IITs. With the 1:10 norm still relevant, questions remain over whether recruitment has kept pace with rising enrolment and expanding academic programmes.
